reconfigure.title: Detect channels again
reconfigure.description: Currently saved: command channel {command}, replies on {reply}. Submit to connect to the device and detect both again, for example after a firmware update. Nothing is changed unless the device answers.

error.invalid_device: This is not a supported Smart Matic device
error.no_reply: The device was found but did not answer a status request on any known command channel. Move it closer to a Bluetooth adapter or proxy, make sure no other app is connected to it, and try again.

update_status.name: Update status
update_status.description: Connects to the Godrej Aer Smart Matic device and refreshes its status. Bypasses the automatic retry cooldown. If no target is given, every configured device is updated.
